notes.title: Eufloria Classic Open Beta Last Call!
notes.content:
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3254570/Eufloria_Classic/"][/dynamiclink]Join the Beta
Eufloria Classic is the upcoming anniversary edition of Eufloria, and it is now in open beta. If you'd like to join the beta, simply join our Discord server and follow the instructions in the #join-test channel.
CLICK HERE TO JOIN OUR DISCORD SERVER
Or use this link if the button doesn't work - https://discord.com/invite/unsbgkR23z
Streaming/Recording
We encourage any beta participants to record, live stream, and share clips/screenshots of the game wherever they like. We're especially interested in people testing the two new modes, and please remember this is a beta and bugs are to be expected.
